summary: Target within 20' becomes Insubstantial and must go directly to their base, ending the State on arrival; a Forced Movement effect.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Insubstantial while travelling to base; must end it immediately on arrival as per Insubstantial (E2).

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Must move directly to their base; a Forced Movement effect (N3). Ends if the Insubstantial State ends first (N1).

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: When cast on self: the caster is Insubstantial on the way to base and may end it at any time with the Insubstantial exit incantation (N2).

effects.subject: caster
effects.note: When cast on self: the caster travels directly to their base (Forced Movement).

termination.note: On arriving at base the player must immediately end the effect as per Insubstantial.
If the Insubstantial State ends before reaching base, the rest of the effect (the travel to base) ends too.
Only when Lost was cast on self: the caster may end the Insubstantial State at any time with the Insubstantial exit incantation.

clarifications.text: Ending the Insubstantial State early also ends the requirement to keep travelling to base.
Lost may be cast on self; then the caster may leave the Insubstantial State whenever they choose using its exit incantation.
